name: NXP Semiconductors
fiscalYearEnd: December 31 (quarters end on the nearest Sunday, e.g. 2026-06-28)
description: NXP makes chips for cars and connected devices: automotive processors, radar, in-vehicle networking and secure microcontrollers, industrial and IoT microcontrollers and wireless, mobile secure-element and NFC chips, and communication-infrastructure parts. Automotive is 58 percent of revenue. It sells 57 percent through distributors (Avnet alone 23 percent of total revenue) and the rest direct. It reports one segment and splits revenue by end market. In 2026 it sold its MEMS Sensors business (cash proceeds $878M in H1 2026), and it holds a 10 percent stake in the ESMC fab joint venture in Germany with TSMC, Bosch and Infineon.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label as shown on Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (columns GICS Sector and GICS Sub-Industry). That page does not show the industry group or industry, so those are null rather than filled from memory.

hq.note: Dutch N.V. that files 10-Ks with the SEC (FY2025 10-K cover lists Netherlands / Eindhoven)

employees.note: About 32,169 employees worldwide; 11,034 work in R&D (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Automotive
businessLines.how: Chips sold per unit to car makers and Tier 1 suppliers (Bosch, Denso, Aptiv and others), designed in years before production and shipped over the vehicle program life.
businessLines.description: Automotive processors, radar, in-vehicle networking, secure car-access and battery-management chips.

businessLines.name: Industrial & IoT
businessLines.how: Chips sold per unit, largely through distributors, into long-lived industrial and IoT designs.
businessLines.description: Microcontrollers, processors, connectivity and secure chips for industrial and IoT equipment.

businessLines.name: Mobile
businessLines.how: Chips sold per unit to handset makers (Apple and Samsung are among NXP's 10 largest end customers), tied to phone model launches.
businessLines.description: Secure elements and NFC/secure-transaction chips for smartphones and mobile devices.

businessLines.name: Communication Infrastructure & Other
businessLines.how: Chips sold per unit to network equipment makers; this line fell 23.6% in FY2025 and grew 41.3% in Q2 2026.
businessLines.description: Network and infrastructure chips plus other products.

whatsNext.text: ESMC fab (Dresden) initial production targeted to begin in 2028; NXP holds 10% and is entitled to 10% of capacity
